description: Add set-base-P/T, add/lose types and abilities, set color, and become-copy effects with durations (EOT, until next turn, permanent) and X-valued P/T.

feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events/filters for combat damage to a planeswalker or creature, playing a land, a permanent entering tapped, cycling a card, and a land-entering filter on trigger doubling.
Let manaValueAtMost/AtLeast/equals take a Value (announced X, count of Shrines, graveyard permanent count, dead target's mana value) instead of a fixed number.

Add conditions for this-turn history: attacked, descended, any player (incl. you) lost N life, nonland permanent left battlefield / spell warped, Pirates dealt combat damage, creatures died under your control.

feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player-scope/chooser fields so each player (or the event player/chosen opponent) performs hand-shuffle, sacrifice choice, return-to-hand, draw, mana and graveyard returns.

feature: Conditions on the triggering object or event player
description: Add conditions on the trigger object/event player: power equals toughness, 'other than the entering permanent', event player's own turn, defending player poisoned, cast from hand.
Model evoke (sacrifice on entry), ninjutsu-style return, mayhem, buyback, encore and paradigm as alternative casts with their rider ops.

feature: Grant landwalk, horsemanship and afflict keywords
description: Add landwalk (forestwalk, mountainwalk), horsemanship and afflict to IMPLEMENTED_KEYWORDS so addKeyword/static grants work.
Add a repeat-until-predicate reveal/exile/mill op (until creature/land/instant card or N cards) with rest to bottom/graveyard and optional cast or hand.

feature: Mana spend restrictions by spell/cost predicate
description: Extend ManaRestriction with predicates: costs containing X, colored spells without X, nonartifact spells only (abilities/artifact spells allowed).

feature: Enter-with-counters rider on blink, reanimation and copy
description: Let blink/graveyardToBattlefield/copy-as-enters ops place (variable) +1/+1 counters on the returned object.

feature: Another player's optional choice on resolution
description: Add an effect where another player decides on resolution (opponent may sacrifice, each player may discard, defending player may let you draw) with a fallback branch.

feature: Random selection of permanent, player or card
description: Add random-choice ops: random one of chosen permanents, random player per permanent with control change, random card from hand to reveal/cast.

feature: Announced X where a fixed number is required
description: Allow announced X (or a Value) for look-at-top counts, target counts and repeat counts (populate X times).

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Support 'any number of target' slots, distributing counters among them, and a Value counting the cards/targets chosen.
Extend costReduction/tax with conditions: spell cast from graveyard, target is tapped, spells targeting this creature, spells the drawing player casts.

feature: Modern keyword actions (venture, ring tempts, suspect, crime)
description: Add venture, the Ring tempts you, suspect state and commit-a-crime trigger.
Add a Value reading the power or mana value of the permanent sacrificed as a cost or additional cost.
Add static grants of retrace (cast from graveyard by discarding a land) and umbra armor to cards/Auras.
Generalize tokenCreationReplacement to any token type (Food, Treasure, Clue), add-extra-token and choose-between-token-specs variants.
Add an incubate effect creating an Incubator token with X +1/+1 counters and its {2} transform into a 0/0 artifact creature.
Add AbilityCost forms: exert this permanent, return a land you control to hand, exile a creature card from graveyard.
Let selectors/ops scope to a targeted player's permanents (tap all, destroy all, return each commander).

feature: Cross-player hand and graveyard comparison values
description: Add Values for hand-size difference vs a chosen opponent, opponents with more cards in hand, and a single opponent's graveyard count.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add ops to put a card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, or attached to a chosen creature.
Add exile with a delayed return including optional immediate return, attached Auras and returning all cards exiled by the source.
Add counter variants: counter then put on battlefield under your control, counter unless pay X with tap-lands penalty, lose life per creature for countered object's controller.

feature: Count of objects affected by the previous effect
description: Add a Value for 'for each creature destroyed/sacrificed this way' counting results of the preceding effect.

feature: Ability and spell copying with source filters
description: Allow copying activated and triggered abilities filtered by source (enchantment, other legendary non-commander) and a copied permanent spell rider.

feature: Static permission to cast spells with flash
description: Add static rule letting players cast (matching) spells as though they had flash, optionally only during a given step.
Add a static alternative cost for all/some spells (pay WUBRG, pay {0} once per turn for colorless from hand).
Support 'unless you return a land / tap two creatures' as a choice with sacrifice-or-draw fallback.
Add can't-be-blocked-except-by / by-creatures-matching restrictions (Walls only, power 2 or less).

feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Make powerAtMost and hasKeyword predicates usable in target filters and continuous statics (layer-aware).
Add Value division with round-down (half the Zombies, half the non-God creatures).

feature: Counters read from events and other permanents
description: Add Values for number/kind of counters placed in the triggering event and counters on another permanent (token P/T).
Add Values counting differently named lands and different powers among creatures.
Add maximum-hand-size reduction and time-limited no-maximum-hand-size.
Add 'you win the game' effect and can't-lose/can't-win static.
Add devour N: choose creatures to sacrifice on entry and count them for counters.
Add a this-turn replacement exiling creatures damaged by the effect that would die.
Add permanent prevent combat damage dealt by self and colored-source damage shields.

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add cast-from-opponent-graveyard and reveal-top-then-cast-if-equal-mana-value ops.
Add single-shared-color X mana and optional addMana.
Add per-vote effects for council's dilemma and a players-finish-voting trigger.

feature: Face-down pile split with opponent choice
description: Add two-pile split where an opponent chooses which pile goes to hand.
Add a selector for cards sharing a creature type with the source or dying creature.
Lines needing a bespoke mechanic found on a single card.
